steps.name: broker_proxy_agentd_smoke
steps.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
STATE_PATH="${AGENT_DEVSTACK_STATE:-out/devstack_state.json}"
if [[ ! -f "${STATE_PATH}" ]]; then
  echo "missing devstack state: ${STATE_PATH}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
BROKER_BASE="{{env.BROKER_BASE}}"
AGENTD_AUTH_TOKEN="{{env.AGENTD_AUTH_TOKEN}}"
TOKEN="$(tools/devstack_oidc_token.sh --state "${STATE_PATH}")"
python3 - <<'PY' "${TOKEN}" > "{{run_dir}}/broker_token_claims.json"
import base64, json, sys
parts = sys.argv[1].split('.')
if len(parts) < 2:
    raise SystemExit('invalid token')
payload = parts[1] + '=' * (-len(parts[1]) % 4)
claims = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload.encode()).decode())
json.dump(claims, sys.stdout, indent=2)
PY
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" "${BROKER_BASE}/v1/agents" > "{{run_dir}}/broker_agents.json"
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "X-Agentd-Authorization: Bearer ${AGENTD_AUTH_TOKEN}" "${BROKER_BASE}/v1/agents/agent1/proxy/api/v1/health" > "{{run_dir}}/broker_proxy_health.json"
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "X-Agentd-Authorization: Bearer ${AGENTD_AUTH_TOKEN}" "${BROKER_BASE}/v1/agents/agent1/proxy/api/v1/diagnostics" > "{{run_dir}}/broker_proxy_diagnostics.json"
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "X-Agentd-Authorization: Bearer ${AGENTD_AUTH_TOKEN}" "${BROKER_BASE}/v1/agents/agent1/proxy/api/v1/caps" > "{{run_dir}}/broker_proxy_caps.json"
curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "X-Agentd-Authorization: Bearer ${AGENTD_AUTH_TOKEN}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' "${BROKER_BASE}/v1/agents/agent1/sessions" > "{{run_dir}}/broker_session_new.json"
python3 - <<'PY' > "{{run_dir}}/summary.json"
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
run_dir = Path("{{run_dir}}")
claims = json.loads((run_dir / 'broker_token_claims.json').read_text())
agents = json.loads((run_dir / 'broker_agents.json').read_text())
health = json.loads((run_dir / 'broker_proxy_health.json').read_text())
diagnostics = json.loads((run_dir / 'broker_proxy_diagnostics.json').read_text())
caps = json.loads((run_dir / 'broker_proxy_caps.json').read_text())
session_new = json.loads((run_dir / 'broker_session_new.json').read_text())
summary = {
  'scenario': 'broker_proxy_agentd_smoke',
  'issuer_host': str(claims.get('iss', '')).split('/')[2].split(':')[0] if claims.get('iss') else '',
  'agent_id': ((agents.get('agents') or [{}])[0]).get('agent_id', ''),
  'agents_count': len(agents.get('agents') or []),
  'proxy_health_ok': bool(health.get('ok')),
  'diagnostics_service': diagnostics.get('service', ''),
  'caps_ok': bool(caps.get('ok')),
  'session_created': bool(session_new.get('ok')) and bool(session_new.get('session_id')),
}
json.dump(summary, sys.stdout, indent=2)
PY
